name: timeout
description: Session length in seconds. Defaults to 900. Must match the server's real session length — a dialog that disagrees with the server is worse than none.

name: warning
description: Seconds before expiry to warn. Defaults to 120. WCAG 2.2.1 requires at least 20 seconds.

name: signOutUrl
description: Where to send the user on expiry, and the destination of the Sign out link.

name: keepAliveUrl
description: Endpoint fetched to extend the session. If the fetch fails the warning reappears rather than silently pretending to have succeeded.

name: title
description: Dialog heading. Defaults to `You are about to be signed out`.

name: text
description: Extra paragraph, for example what happens to unsaved answers.

name: keepAliveText
description: Primary button text. Defaults to `Stay signed in`.

name: signOutText
description: Sign out link text. Defaults to `Sign out`.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the dialog.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the dialog.
